text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Phalaenopsis was not feeling well, 
I decided to have her rest 
in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Countless arrows pierce the trees and 
balustrades— 
What is this sight? It's just like a 
battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And you—the one hiding in the shadows over 
there. 
Why do you look upon me with such 
frightened eyes?

text_block_list.name: Frightened Villager
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! Y-You... 
Ain't you one of them bandits?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Bandits, you say? 
I should like to hear what is happening.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I see. In essence, 
a band of bandits plans to raid 
your village as soon as tonight.

text_block_list.name: Frightened Villager
text_block_list.text:
Owooh... It's the end 
for our village...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fret not. 
...I know how to wage war.

text_block_list.name: Bandit Leader
text_block_list.text:
Gahahahaha!! Men, plunder to your hearts' 
content! 
Pillage, steal, strip everything to the 
bone!

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Ghehehehe— 
Wait, gwaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Bandit Leader
text_block_list.text:
!? Wh-What?! A pitfall trap?! 
The entire area has been laid with 
traps...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now is our chance! Men, to arms! 
Capture every last one of the bandits!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now then. The enemy leader is—over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Panicked Bandits
text_block_list.text:
"!? Wh-What is going on?!" 
"The t-torches—they've all been shot down 
by arrows! 
Who in the world is that woman?!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—This world is survival of the fittest. 
I shall not deny that this, too, is a 
principle of the world.

text_block_list.name: Bandit Leader
text_block_list.text:
! That's her voice! She's close! 
Men, get her, get her!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However—those who rely on blade, spear, 
arrow, and shot 
must never forget one thing.

text_block_list.name: Bandit Leader
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey?! Someone answer me! 
...A-A light... Bring a light...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—That the time shall inevitably come to 
atone for your evil deeds.

text_block_list.name: Bandit Leader
text_block_list.text: H-Hiiiiieeeeeeeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The bandits have all been captured alive. 
You have nothing left to fear.

text_block_list.name: Rejoicing Villagers
text_block_list.text:
"The v-village is saved...!!" 
"Bless you, bless you...!" 
"Miladyyyy...!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I have had another grandiose dream, it 
seems. 
Though—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Rampaging to my heart's content seems to 
have lifted my spirits a bit. 
My body feels light...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having returned from the infirmary, 
Phalaenopsis 
seemed thoroughly refreshed in both body 
and mind!
